# S-21.07-test: fixture for T-047 PC40 volatile-input test

Fixture: story with `input-hash: abc123` AND `inputs: [".factory/STATE.md"]`.

`.factory/STATE.md` is a VOLATILE path — it changes on every fix burst and is not a
stable input to the story spec. PC40 (BC-5.39.010 v1.6 amendment) requires that when
volatile paths are present in `inputs:`, Arm B1 must emit advisory + Continue rather
than proceeding with the three-way comparison.

The STORY-INDEX.md sibling fixture has a DIFFERENT catalog hash (`xyz789`) to prove
that PC40 suppresses the comparison: without PC40, B1 would detect mismatch and block
(exit 2). With PC40, the volatile path triggers advisory + Continue (exit 0).

BC-5.39.010 v1.6 PC40: volatile inputs → advisory + Continue.
